post.author: Santos N. Garcia
post.topic_summary: Demonstration of integrating Claude Desktop with Ignition SCADA using Inductive Automation's Early Access MCP Module to enable AI interaction with SCADA/MES environments.

comment_posted.comment_text:
The MCP connection is the easy part. Live tag reads give you current state, but most Ignition tag trees have grown organically over years: names that made sense to the controls engineer who built the project don't translate directly to an AI context window.

Before the time-series question is reliably answerable, you need a semantic layer that maps raw tag paths to process concepts, units, and normal operating ranges. Query the historian through that model, not through the raw tag tree. The demo is a solid proof of concept; the production path goes through the data model first.
